article.title: Right to legal representation.
article.content: Notwithstanding anything contained in any law, no party to a proceeding before a Tribunal or Appellate Tribunal shall be represented by a legal practitioner.
article.html:
17Right to legal representation.

Section 17 · Chapter II · page 7 of the Act

Notwithstanding anything contained in any law, no party to a proceeding before a Tribunal or Appellate Tribunal shall be represented by a legal practitioner.
